messages.subject: RE: Hartnell - draft settlement agreement (our mark-up)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Elena,

My mark-up is attached. The substantive changes are: the termination payment increased to £247,500 with the balance updated accordingly; PMI extended to six months; the costs contribution to £1,500 plus VAT; and the covenant period at nine months as discussed. I've left the agreed-reference schedule largely as drafted with a couple of tweaks.

Subject to those changes my client is content to sign. Please send a clean execution version once the Tribunal-withdrawal clause is added.

Eleanor Bartlett

Eleanor Bartlett
Partner | Employment
Ashworth Quinn LLP
DX 233 Birmingham

Dear Ms Bartlett,

Thank you - the changes are all agreed and consistent with our discussion. We'll add a clause dealing with withdrawal and dismissal of the Tribunal claim (case 2601839/2026) and send a clean execution version for signature. We anticipate completion around the time of our client's Board meeting in late April.
